items.name: Apollo CSM + Lunar Module
items.description: The command/service module carries the crew and its AJ10 main engine handles lunar orbit and return. The attached lunar module carries two crew members down to the surface and back, and is discarded before the trip home.
items.source: NASA Apollo spacecraft reference; capabilities derived from LM descent/ascent and SPS burn budgets · power/comms figures are gameplay approximations from public mission profiles

items.name: Orion
items.description: NASA's next-generation crew capsule with a European-built service module. Designed to carry four astronauts into deep space and return them safely to Earth. Its service module cannot land on the Moon on its own.
items.source: NASA Orion fact sheet; service module delta-v capability approximated · power/comms figures are gameplay approximations from public mission profiles

items.name: Orion + Human Landing System
items.description: Orion crew capsule docked with a dedicated human landing system (Starship-class). The lander carries the crew from lunar orbit to the south pole surface and back to Orion for the trip home. This is the architecture NASA plans for Artemis III.
items.source: Artemis III mission architecture (SLS + Orion + Human Landing System); capabilities derived from planned burn budgets · power/comms figures are gameplay approximations from public mission profiles

items.name: Perseverance Rover Package
items.description: Automated delivery stack: cruise stage, aeroshell with descent stage, and the Perseverance-class rover. Designed for a direct entry into the Mars atmosphere, so it needs almost no arrival burn.
items.source: NASA Mars 2020 press kit; figures approximated for gameplay · power/comms figures are gameplay approximations from public mission profiles

items.name: Science Orbiter
items.description: Compact automated spacecraft based on MAVEN-class designs. Can carry a science payload suite to Mars and brake into orbit using its own main engine.
items.source: NASA MAVEN mission fact sheet; figures approximated for gameplay · power/comms figures are gameplay approximations from public mission profiles
